messages.content: How do I use Text Generation WebUI for inference?

Text Generation WebUI (oobabooga) is a powerful interface for LLM inference:

## Installation
```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/oobabooga/text-generation-webui
cd text-generation-webui

# One-click installer (recommended)
# Windows: start_windows.bat
# Linux: ./start_linux.sh
# macOS: ./start_macos.sh

# Or manual:
pip install -r requirements.txt
python server.py
```

## Enable API Server
```bash
# Start with API enabled
python server.py --api --api-port 5000

# Or add to CMD_FLAGS.txt:
--api
--api-port 5000
```

## Download Models
1. Go to the **Model** tab
2. Enter model name: `TheBloke/Llama-2-13B-chat-GPTQ`
3. Click **Download**
4. Load the model

The API will be available at `http://localhost:5000/v1`!

Text Generation WebUI supports multiple model loaders:

## Loaders

| Loader | Use Case | GPU Memory |
|--------|----------|------------|
| **Transformers** | Default, HuggingFace models | High |
| **llama.cpp** | GGUF quantized models | Low-Medium |
| **ExLlamaV2** | GPTQ/EXL2 quantized, fast | Medium |
| **AutoGPTQ** | GPTQ models | Medium |
| **GPTQ-for-LLaMa** | Legacy GPTQ | Medium |
| **ctransformers** | GGML models | Low |
| **AutoAWQ** | AWQ quantized models | Medium |

## Recommended Combinations

```
Full precision    → Transformers
GGUF (4-8 bit)    → llama.cpp
GPTQ              → ExLlamaV2 (fastest)
AWQ               → AutoAWQ
EXL2              → ExLlamaV2
```

## Memory Tips
- Use GGUF Q4_K_M for best quality/size ratio
- Enable `--load-in-4bit` for transformers
- Use `--n-gpu-layers` to offload to GPU with llama.cpp
